description: A 2HP indicator: a tall lamp that flashes on a trigger and otherwise shows the level of a mono mix

inputs.text: A rising edge flashes the lamp yellow for 0.2 seconds
Shown as a vertical level bar reading over 48dB, with 4.8V at the top; reaching 4.8V turns the whole lamp red for half a second

notes: the module has no outputs and changes nothing. It only shows what is patched to it
a trigger flash covers the level bar while it lasts, and a peak warning covers both

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
